dict.string: Rota controls Chrome to reuse existing bookmark tabs and, only if you opt in to Screen Time website tracking, read the active public tab’s domain for local-only usage insights.

Rota reads ZSA Navigator touch reports and, when enabled, Apple trackpad touches for gesture actions. Pointer movement pauses while an Apple-controlled App Explorer or Window Manager is open; normal movement resumes when it closes or enters editing.

Voice Mode sends spoken commands to your selected provider: OpenAI for live speech-to-text search, or OpenRouter/xAI for transcription and text plus action descriptions to Jev for matching. Dictate note sends audio to OpenRouter/xAI for transcription only; the resulting temporary note stays on this Mac for 30 minutes and never affects action choices. Private intention dictation uses on-device recognition and keeps audio and recognized text on this Mac.
Rota uses Apple's on-device speech recognition to draft an editable temporary intention. Audio and recognized text stay on this Mac.
